newsitem.title: UK: Oslo bourse to price Color Line bid Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Oslo bourse to price Color Line bid Wednesday.

text.p: Norwegian ferry operator Larvik Scandi Line expects to hear Wednesday what price per share will be set for its bid for rival company Color Line ASA.
Larvik Scandi Line finance director Johannes Sjoflot told Reuters: "It is our opinion that 31.50 kroner should be the price but the Oslo Stock exchange will make the final decision."
"We expect a decision by Wednesday at the latest," he added.
Color Line said last Friday that Larvik Scandi Line had exercised an option on 50,000 shares at an underlying price of Kroner 31.50 per share.
The acquisition took Larvik Scandi Line over a 45 percent holding in Color Line, triggering a requirement for it to make a full bid.

However, Color Lines shares were being traded on the Oslo bourse at kroner 34 thereby requiring the Exchange to set the offer price level. Color Line shares were priced at kroner 33.50 at mid-day Tuesday.
Sjoflot said the maximum offer price would be kroner 32.50 and admitted the Larvik Scandi Line bid was unlikely to receive sufficient shareholder support to go unconditional.
Color Line finance director Inger Klemp said the company would decide on its response to the bid once it knew what price had been set. -Paul Berrill Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017.
